title: Why Street Fighter's New Cammy Looks So Familiar
summary:
Cammy from Street Fighter looks familiar for a good reason: the actor playing her in the new 2026 film has had a busy action-movie career.

Cammy first appeared in Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers in 1993. She is known for her long blonde braids and beret, and belongs to Delta Red, a special forces group.

In the 1994 movie, Kylie Minogue played Cammy. In director Kitao Sakurai's new 2026 film, Thai-born Australian Mel Jarnson plays her.

Her first major film role was villain Nitara in the 2021 film Mortal Kombat. She did not return for Mortal Kombat II.

She later appeared in Blacklight in 2022, Witchboard in 2024, which the article says received some good reviews, and co-led Killer Whale with Virginia Gardner early in 2026.

In the 2026 film, Cammy is a villain working for M. Bison, played by David Dastmalchian, and her role is not very large. She is also scheduled for the upcoming Empire City, playing Leda. Cammy may not be her biggest role, but it is one of her most visible.
why_it_matters: Spotting an actor you have seen before makes movies more fun, like finding a familiar face in a new story.
